A [[Mon Calamari]] '''viceroy''' was the [[parent]] of a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy's son|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="Chapter 22" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|22}}</ref> she believed her son to have absconded with his [[Quarren]] lover [[Captain]] [[Shuggoth]], and hired the [[Mandalorian]] [[privateer]]s [[Axe Woves]] and [[Koska Reeves]] to return her son to their [[Unidentified Mon Calamari palace|palace]].<ref name="Chapter 22" />
